description.text: The promos of Japan's Sun & Moon years, with an SM-P suffix, released from November 2016 to October 2019. The era began on 18 November 2016 with Pikachu's New Friends, and its promos traded the black star for a rectangular PROMO symbol. The largest group came in seasonal Pokémon Card Gym packs; others came from booster pack purchase campaigns, Pokémon Card Station classrooms, Event Organizer Trainer's packs, Champion's League and other championships, special sets, starter decks and boxes, the Pokémon Center, Lawson, CoroCoro Comic and Daiichi Pan.

description.text: Victory Decoration was the trophy card of Japan's Champions League tournaments from the 2017 to the 2020 season. It was never sold or given to entrants: only the top finishers of each league received one, in gold, silver and bronze prints, and each tournament had its own copies with its year and location in the foil. This 3rd Place print, from Champions League 2017 Osaka, went to the players who finished third and fourth in each league.

tell.text: A World Championships stamp on the picture: "Worlds" and the year on early cards, the World Championships logo and year on later ones.
